title: 2D Contour: Lead in/out None still generates a linear lead-in

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: in-review
labels.description: Fix pushed on a branch with an open PR; merges at the next cut

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## What happens

A 2D Contour in `O4 Cam Plate master` still shows a linear lead-in when the user sets **Lead in/out** to **None**.

The user also sets these values:

- **Lead out > Type:** None
- **Before lead-in:** 0.0 mm
- **After lead-out:** 0.0 mm
- **Overlap past the start:** 0.0 mm

The user generates the operation again after the changes. The viewport still shows a straight line at the contour entry.

Changing the lead to **Arc** changes the entry shape. Changing it to **Linear** gives the same straight entry. Changing it back to **None** does not remove that entry.

A screenshot from 2026-11-21 shows the operation `2D Contour1`, the selected **None** values, and the remaining straight segment.

## Expected

When the lead-in and lead-out are **None**, the first XY cutting move starts on the contour path. The path has no straight or arc lead segment before that move.

Entry, plunge, retract, rapid, and level-link moves can remain. They must not appear as a lead feed at the contour seam.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open a project with a closed 2D Contour operation.
2. Open **Lead in / Lead out**.
3. Set **Lead in/out** to **None**.
4. Set **Lead out > Type** to **None**.
5. Set both extensions and the overlap to 0.0 mm.
6. Click **Generate**.
7. Select the first cutting move near the contour seam.
8. Observe the remaining straight entry segment.
9. Change **Lead in/out** to **Arc**, then to **Linear**, then to **None**.
10. Observe that **Arc** and **Linear** change the shape, but **None** restores the straight entry instead of removing it.

## Related

Issue #3019 covers a generated linear lead that crosses its own ring. The report also says that `lead: "none"` posts. This issue covers a different result: the UI and the posted path still contain an entry lead when the user selects **None**.

## Done means

- A UI or app test changes a Contour from a linear lead to **None**, applies the draft, and generates the operation.
- A test asserts that the first cutting move starts on the contour path with no added lead segment.
- A test covers an explicit **Lead out > None** value with zero extensions and zero overlap.
- The generated path and posted output contain no linear or arc lead when both lead shapes are **None**.
- A regression test proves that **Arc** and **Linear** still generate their selected shapes.

Changelog: A 2D Contour with both lead shapes set to None no longer keeps a linear lead-in in the generated path (#3132).
